tools.name: get_crime_data
tools.description: Crime safety grade and nearby incident counts for one US address or coordinate pair. Returns a letter score (A+ safest through F), a short description of that grade, and — in cities where police publish incident data — counts by crime type within 1000ft for the same period the grade was built from (

tools.name: get_neighborhood_data
tools.description: Profile of the neighborhood (or census block group) containing one US address or coordinate pair: demographics, median household income, home values, rent by bedroom count, education attainment, cost-of-living indices, climate and natural-disaster risk. Use this when the question is about who lives

tools.name: search_offenders
tools.description: Search US registered offenders in one of two modes. Location mode: pass address or lat+lng, plus an optional radius in miles (default 1, capped at 3); results include each offender's distance from the search point. Name mode: pass at least one of first_name, last_name or dob, optionally narrowed by

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: Report the plan, monthly and daily call usage, remaining quota, reset times, rate limit and overage status for the DoorProfit API key authenticating this session. Takes no arguments — it always describes the calling key, never another account. Call it when the user asks how many calls they have left

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_api_usage" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Report the plan, monthly and daily call usage, remaining quota, reset times, rate limit and overage status for the DoorProfit API key authenticating this sessio…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_crime_data · Private data: get_crime_data, get_neighborhood_data, search_offenders, get_api_usage · Public sink: get_crime_data · Destructive: get_api_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_crime_data · Private data: get_crime_data, get_neighborhood_data, search_offenders, get_api_usage · Public sink: get_crime_data · Destructive: get_api_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
